notes.title: Protect Your Fool will become completely free!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Guardian Protectors![/p][p][/p][p]We have some big news: Protect Your Fool will become completely free![/p][p]We want our little arcade game to reach more people, so we are switching to a “Free-To-Play” model.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe that anyone looking for an arcade game with high difficulty, progression, and quick response time improvement will enjoy Protect Your Fool![/p][p][/p][p]The migration to the ‘Free To Play’ model will take place within 1 month.[/p][p]We hope you like the news, and that Protect Your Fool grows on you.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a great day![/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104010/086296bbaf704d2b02540c22e74912c0ea8ef0b8.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104010/086296bbaf704d2b02540c22e74912c0ea8ef0b8.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]

notes.title: Baby Fool is waiting for you!
notes.content:
Guardian Protectors,

Some of you requested a softer and adaptable experience at the beginning of the journey.

We heard you and created an Easy difficulty, specially made for the less experienced.

The new difficulty is intended for a more balanced climb, so the adventure still begins in Normal mode. Therefore, Steam Achievements are disabled on this difficulty.

Easy difficulty features:

- Choose which theme you want to play on.
- Improved learning curve.
- Protect our new dear Baby Fool.
- Fewer enemy objects on screen.
- Level 10 is an introduction to more challenging enemy objects.
- New victory trophy will make you jaw drop.

The Baby Fool is in trouble, trapped in a little nightmare. Don't make him wake up crying from the nightmare. Protect the Baby Fool!
